page.layout: Running head at top centre with page number 340 at the upper left. Main text in one column on the right, with a narrow column of marginal notes on the left. Below the text, the catchword COLLE- at the lower right. A woodcut ornament sits lower on the page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Seruitutem& manumiffionem v. l. 92. §. de solutio. {a}a mortalitati{b} fere comparamus.v. l. 59. in f. §. de conditt. & demonstr.
Qux ab initio{c} inutilis fuit institutio, ex postfacto{d} conualescere non potest.v. l. 29. §. eo.i. tractu temporis.
Seruus{e} reipublicæ causa abesse non potest.adde L. 140. §. eod.

page.notes: The initial letters are large woodcut-style capitals; "Seruitutem" and "Seruus" are read from their small-capital second letters, which look like E and may be a printed convention. The word after the 209 entry-line initial is doubtful and marked on its first letter. "Edi(ctum" has a stray mark where the ligature ct would be, so it is queried. The notes column is set in small type; the note e entry's "L. 140." is read as printed. Faint show-through text in the lower half of the page is not transcribed.
